capabilities: render charts in notes from code blocks
extras: Not yet published in the community plugin market; manual install or BRAT is recommended. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README's usage example references a screenshot that was not included.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw data charts from note content; Mermaid covers diagrams but not chart plotting.
summary: Renders ECharts charts in notes from code blocks, using ECharts v6 and compatible with mobile devices.
